name: The Heartwood Bow
description: The singular longbow crafted by Lethariel Heartwood from a Longbough limb offered by the Heartwood itself before the Discordant War — a living artifact carrying residual Heartwood connection.
narrative_effects: Unique artifact held exclusively by Lethariel Heartwood. Kept at Heartwood Estate between her active Heartwarden Captaincy rotations; returns to active service when Sylvara departs for her Proving.
Arrows loosed from the Heartwood Bow carry heightened accuracy and penetrating force in defense of the Heartwood and the Feywood.

The bow's Longbough material is Heartwood-offered and cannot pass to an unsanctioned bearer; attempts to use it by another party produce no magical effect and the bow's ambient-field register shifts in ways trained observers recognize.
